RED phase: comprehensive failing tests covering all 14 acceptance criteria

Core crate tests (AC-2 through AC-8):

- PluginError: 8 variants, Display, Error, Send+Sync, matchable (AC-7)
- AxiathonPlugin: lifecycle, object safety, Send+Sync, error paths (AC-2)

Sub-crate tests (AC-9 through AC-12):
- Ingestion: RawEvent, ConnectorPlugin, ParserPlugin, EventEnricher (AC-9)
- Network: ProtocolDissector, ProtocolInfo (AC-10)
- Notification: NotificationChannel, Notification (AC-11)
- Action: ResponseAction, ActionCapabilities, ActionResult (AC-12)

Cross-cutting (AC-1, AC-13):
- Facade re-export test verifying all sub-crates accessible (AC-1)
- Object safety compile tests for all 7 traits (AC-13)

Also fixes pre-existing test quality issues in axiathon-core:
- Remove tautological error propagation tests (construct-then-match)
- Remove tautological struct field tests (set-then-assert)
- Replace Result type alias test with meaningful ?-operator test
- Add missing Validation error variant assertion on too-long TenantId
- Add ApiResponse dual-state documentation test
EOF
